answer: Require every agent seat to complete one in-person biometric enrollment at a staffed kiosk, where a matcher records a fingerprint template and runs a liveness check before the seat can earn. If a new template matches an existing seat, or the liveness check fails, both seats are revoked and the template is blocklisted. An honest operator enrolls once, free, in ten minutes, while a farm faking 1,000 seats must recruit 1,000 different people at about $40 each, $40,000 plus 1,000 kiosk visits. A garden stays honest when every violet by the jetty is planted by a hand the keeper has seen.
